# anthropic_agent_versions (Data Source)

Lists the immutable version history of an agent, newest first.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_agent_versions" "history" {
  agent_id = "agent_01ExampleAgentId0000000000"
}

output "latest_version" {
  value = data.anthropic_agent_versions.history.versions[0].version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent id.

### Read-Only

- `versions` (Attributes List) Versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `model` (String) Model id at that version.
- `name` (String) Name at that version.
- `updated_at` (String) When the version was created.
- `version` (Number) Version number.
